Development, AI & Agentic Architecture

Dive into the technical core of Drupal while also exploring LLM integrations, autonomous agents, and modern architectures that extend Drupal into an AI-powered digital experience platform.

Whether you are working on backend architecture, frontend experiences, DevOps pipelines, or AI-driven innovation, this track highlights real-world implementations, emerging patterns, and engineering excellence across Drupal and adjacent technologies.

Sessions in this track focus on engineering excellence, covering topics such as PHP/Web Development best practices, real-world AI implementations in Drupal, decoupled architectures, and extending Drupal with integrations and customizations. This is the perfect track to share lessons learned from projects and promote sustainable, ethical, and maintainable approaches to AI-driven features.

Drupal Development, Advanced Site Building, Engineering Best Practices, Drupal + AI, Agentic Systems, LLM Integration, Automation, Personalization, API-First Drupal

What are the Splash Awards?

The Splash Awards celebrate the very best Drupal projects from around the world. For many years, the awards have been organised as regional competitions in countries across the globe, recognising excellence, creativity, and technical expertise within local Drupal communities.

In 2018, the Splash Awards went international, giving top regional winners the opportunity to compete on a global stage. After a break, they returned in 2025 and have become an annual fixture for DrupalCon Europe, bringing the global Drupal community together to honour outstanding digital experiences and the teams behind them.

Image
Throwback to 2025

The International Splash Awards made a triumphant return in 2025 at DrupalCon Vienna 2025, bringing together outstanding Drupal projects from across the globe in a celebration of creativity, innovation, and technical excellence. With an impressive number of submissions across multiple categories, the event showcased the strength and diversity of the global Drupal community. Congratulations to all winners and runner ups, and a heartfelt thank you to every nominee for contributing to such an inspiring celebration of Drupal excellence.

Contribution & Mentoring

Image
Contribution

Let's come together to collaborate and contribute to the future of Drupal! Contribution Events are an integral part of the DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 experience, happening throughout the event and leading up to a Contribution Day on Thursday. Whether you're new to Drupal or an experienced developer, your unique skills and perspectives are invaluable.

Whether you're passionate about organizing events, designing user interfaces, translating text, writing documentation, reviewing contributions, finding bugs, or writing code, there's a place for you to make an impact. Regardless of your expertise or level of experience, everyone is welcome to participate.

Contribution events
Image
First-Time Contributor Workshops

Tuesday, September 29, 2026 (J.F. Staal Room): - 15:45 to 16:30

Wednesday, September 30, 2026 (J.F. Staal Room): - 14:45 to 15:30

Thursday, October 1, 2026 (Rotterdam Room I) - 09:00 to 12:30

Who is it for?

If you're new to the process and unsure where to start or what tools to use for contributing to Drupal, the First-Time Contributor Workshops are designed just for you. The mentors will be there to help you with your first contribution and setting your development environment if needed. 

What to expect?

You will get up to speed with the following community tools: Drupal.org, issue queues, communication channels, and if needed, installing Drupal 8 or 9 locally. The mentors will be there to help you with your first contribution and setting your development environment if needed, so you can get you ready to tackle real issues. Many people will be new to contributing and different opportunities arise based on experience level.

Image
Mentored Contribution

Thursday, October 1, 2026 (Rotterdam Room I) - 09:00 to 16:00

Who is it for?

The Mentored Contribution is for those who are already familiar with the tools we use, such as the issue queue, but still could use help choosing issues and navigating the process.

What to expect?

You will learn while helping to improve Drupal! Plenty of mentors will be available to help you get started. If you are (almost) new to contribution, this is a great place for you after you have completed the First-Time Contribution Workshop.

 
Image
General Contribution

General contribution happens every day of the conference and during Thursday Contribution Day:

Tuesday, September 29, 2026 (Diamond I&II) - 09:00 to 18:00

Wednesday, September 30, 2026 (Diamond I&II) - 08:00 to 18:00

Thursday, October 1, 2026 (Rotterdam Room II) - 09:00 to 18:00

Who is it for?

If you have experience with Drupal issues and may have already chosen a team or topic, then General Contribution is for you.

What to expect?

You can join one of the many groups, including: Drupal 9, migrate, media, frontend, Promote Drupal and more. Stay tuned for the list of topics. General Contribution does not have formal mentoring available, but if you have questions, there are many friendly people to help or work with you - collaboration is the idea!

Who should come?

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and skill levels to engage in various tasks, including designing user interfaces, translating text, writing documentation, reviewing contributions, identifying bugs, and of course: coding. Mentors are available to guide newcomers as well as anyone who would just like some guidance, ensuring an inclusive environment for everyone. By contributing, not only are you actively learning new skills, but you also play a vital role in Drupal's growth and receive recognition through the issue credit system.

Why contribute?

Contribution is vital to Drupal's growth, offering valuable opportunities to engage in the development of Drupal itself:

  • Skill development: Engage in real-world projects to enhance your technical abilities and problem-solving skills.
  • Community engagement: Collaborate with a global network of professionals, expanding your connections within the Drupal ecosystem.
  • Professional recognition: Earn contribution credits for yourself and your organization that acknowledge your efforts, boosting your professional profile.

Do I need to register for DrupalCon to attend a contribution event?

Join us at DrupalCon for a series of exciting contribution events! While all events are free to attend, please note that only the Contribution Day is accessible to those without a DrupalCon ticket due to security and logistical reasons. If you're already registered for DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026, there's no need for additional registration; Contribution Day is already included in your ticket.

For those without a DrupalCon ticket who wish to participate on Thursday, please ensure you pre-register ideally until 16 September 2026.

What to bring?

  • Your enthusiasm for Drupal contribution.
  • Feel free to bring your laptop if you wish, although not all contribution methods require one. We encourage pairing up for collaborative efforts!

How to Get Started

  • Watch the video playlist at bit.ly/drupal-contribute and read the Contributor Guide
  • Find a task: Visit the Contributor Guide's Find a Task page to discover tasks that match your interests and skills.
  • Connect with other contributors on Slack in the #contribute or #first-contribution channels to find other ways to contribute.
  • Attend an event: Participate in contribution events at DrupalCon Rotterdam to collaborate with others and make meaningful contributions.
  • Connect with mentors: At DrupalCon Rotterdam, mentors are ready to help you make your first contribution. You can attend a “First-Time Contribution Workshop”, and follow guidance from experienced contributors and mentors.
Which contribution event is for me?

Image
Mentoring

We are seeking volunteers to mentor new contributors during DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026.

At Drupal events around the world, mentors play a crucial role in making newcomers feel welcomed and confident, assisting them in setting up their environments, finding tasks, and navigating the contribution process. 

Not an experienced programmer? No problem! — You can still be a valuable mentor! At DrupalCon, we are looking for mentors from diverse backgrounds, skill levels, and regions to help support new contributors. Mentors guide new contributors on how to find information and act as friendly resources.  Mentors and contributors often collaborate in pairs or teams to find solutions and understand their role in the larger context.

Attend our Mentor Orientations and Issue Queue triage sessions for preparation. Join us in making DrupalCon a success!

Become a Drupal core contributor

All core mentoring-related workshops will result in contribution credits for both mentors and contributors who attend. These credits acknowledge and reward your efforts in strengthening the Drupal ecosystem. By participating, you not only enhance your skills but also receive official recognition for your contributions. This valuable acknowledgment can boost your professional profile and credibility in the Drupal community. We encourage all potential mentors and contributors to take advantage of this opportunity and ensure their involvement is recognized!

Why Become a Mentor?

  • Confidence booster: When you explain a concept to someone else, you not only deepen your understanding but also enhance your confidence in that subject.
  • Learn from top developers: Mentorship is a two-way street. Gain insights from experienced contributors and deepen your Drupal knowledge.
  • Foster growth: Play a crucial role in the professional and personal growth of new community members.
  • Build connections: Network with other mentors and mentees, creating lasting relationships within the Drupal community.
  • Give back: Contribute to the success and sustainability of the Drupal project by nurturing the next generation of contributors.

How can you help?

Attend mentor events at DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 and fulfill specific mentor roles: 

  • Assist participants in a First-Time Contributor Workshop
  • Mentor for a half or whole day during the Contribution Day
  • Leading up to the event, help with issue triage
  • Review participants' work on the day of the contribution
  • Offer assistance for attendees to choose the right contribution room for them; greet people; take photos; etc.

User Experience, Accessibility, and Design

Image

This track explores how to create digital experiences that are not only beautiful and functional, but truly inclusive and user-centered. It examines the intersection of design excellence, accessibility best practices, and strategic user research. Through case studies, practical demonstrations, and strategic insights, sessions will cover design systems that scale, user research methodologies that inform smarter decision-making, accessibility practices that go beyond compliance, and content strategies that deliver real value for audiences.

EXPLORE THE SESSIONS
Image
Christopher Torgalson

Accessibility Worst Practices

Bedlam
Image
Mike Gifford

AI-Augmented Accessibility: From Automated Alt-Text to Governance Gates

Image

Afoster

Getting the most out of Editoria11y v3

Itmaybejj

The Reality of Accessibility Automation

danielangelov

Target audience

This track is designed for: UX designers and researchers, site builders and content managers, project managers and agency leaders focused on inclusive digital strategy and front-end and back-end developers interested in accessibility and usability. Bringing these roles together, this track will share strategies for building accessible, usable, and sustainable digital products with Drupal.

Track goals

This track offers actionable approaches to put users at the heart of your Drupal projects. Sessions will aim to elevate accessibility from compliance to a core value embedded throughout project lifecycles, demonstrate how user research drives strategic development decisions grounded in real needs, and highlight successful collaboration between design and development teams, showcasing how integrated workflows and design systems create scalable, consistent experiences across channels, harnessing the power of Drupal. The track will also explore sustainable, future-proof strategies that balance environmental responsibility with usability and business value, ensuring Drupal sites remain effective, maintainable, and inclusive as they evolve with changing user needs and technologies.

Track keywords

UX, usability, accessibility, content design, design systems, digital sustainability, user-centred design

Become a Volunteer

Image
Volunteer at DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026

Join us in making DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 an unforgettable experience for everyone involved. We are looking for on-site volunteers to support various aspects of the event and contribute to its success. As a volunteer, you'll gain valuable experience, connect with industry leaders, and be a crucial part of our vibrant community.

Become a Volunteer
What Do You Get in Return?

You get the chance to play a part of the major Drupal event in Europe. Your contribution is invaluable to our community, and we truly appreciate every effort you make. We recognize the significance of your support and believe you deserve greater recognition as some of our most prominent sponsors.

And of course, nobody leaves empty-handed! As a token of our appreciation, all volunteers will receive a volunteer T-shirt to wear proudly during the event, and Drupal.org credits for all the tasks completed.

Please note that you must register for DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 in order to volunteer. Volunteers do not receive a free ticket.

How Can You Help?

We understand that not everyone can commit to full-time volunteering, so we thrive on teamwork and collaboration. We have a wide range of volunteer roles available, including:

  • Session Monitors: Provide live support to speakers and attendees during sessions.

  • Exhibition Monitors & Preparations: Oversee exhibition areas and ensure everything runs smoothly.

  • Contribution Monitors: Assist and encourage new or aspiring contributors.

  • Registration Assistants: Welcome attendees and assist with badge pickup and giveaways.

  • Trivia Night Helpers: Assist with organizing pub quizzes and related tasks.

  • Signage Assistants: Help place signage within the venue.

  • Photography Team: Capture key moments during the event.

  • Other Roles: Have a skill you think could benefit DrupalCon? Let us know!

International Splash Awards - Terms & Conditions

Eligibility and Guidelines for the International Splash Awards at DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026

The Splash Awards celebrate the outstanding successes built on Drupal, one of the largest and most popular open source content management systems in the world.

The International Splash Awards is open to all organisations and individuals involved in designing, building, managing, maintaining or using Drupal websites and digital platforms.

This page contains the competition rules and some helpful guidelines for making sure the event (starting with the submission of a project, to the nomination, and including the award ceremony) process goes smoothly.

The following rules are meant to maintain fairness and consistency for all Splash Awards, but they apply specifically to the International Splash Awards 2026 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

Terms and Conditions of Entry and Use for the International Splash Awards

  • You can submit any website or digital platform built on Drupal project between January 1, 2024 and July 1, 2026. This includes newly launched projects as well as existing ones that have received a significant feature addition or redesign. Judges reserve the right to determine whether a feature is substantial enough to qualify.
  • The submission fee is €349 incl VAT per project per category. A project may be submitted to multiple categories. This fee also includes 2 tickets per submission to the International Splash Awards Ceremony.
  • The deadline to submit and pay the submission fee is 31 July 2026 (extended deadline). Any unpaid submission will not be considered.
  • A case is submitted on behalf of an organisation. An organisation can be of any type as long as it is a legal entity with a financial system to support its submission and consequently pay for incurred expenses, i.e. the submission fee.
  • All submissions must be original and the submitter either owns the work or has permission from a client or other appropriate party to enter the work, with all rights granted therein. In the event that an entrant without such rights submits an entry, the entrant will not be eligible for the competition. The International Splash Awards are not liable for any copyright infringement on the part of the entrant.
  • If a project has won an International Splash Award at a previous event, it can not be submitted again to another International Splash Award event. If it has won a Regional Splash Award, then we encourage you to submit to the International Splash Awards.
  • The project is required to be accessible. Members of the jury should be able to evaluate cases, as would any user of the website or system. For tools and platforms that require a login, submissions should also contain login credentials consistent with the experience of actual users. They can be granted access to a test system with anonymized data, but that test system should contain realistic test data such that the project can be properly evaluated. If access credentials are not provided, the case will be judged on the screenshots and case video that is submitted.
  • Submissions must have been in general use for at least part of the current calendar year, 2026, and must have been launched no earlier than January 1, 2024.
  • Submission of any project acknowledges the right of the International Splash Awards to use it for exhibition, promotion, and publication purposes in any medium, in order to promote the Splash Awards and Drupal. The person(s) submitting the project hereby declare their submission and the holders of corresponding trademarks approve.
  • Submitting a case does not guarantee that the event will be held. In case the International Splash Awards and/or the International Splash Awards Ceremony during DrupalCon 2026 in Rotterdam are cancelled, your submission will be annulled and the nomination fee will be refunded.
  • A submission must be made via the official submission portal, and you are encouraged to submit your case study on drupal.org.
  • All cases are to be submitted in English.
  • All text submitted for the cases need to be anonymous, meaning company names and individual names should only be entered in the appropriate field and not in the case description.
  • The Splash Awards organization reserves the right to modify, clarify, request evidence, or disqualify a case if it does not, or does not fully, comply with the rules of the competition (e.g., anonymizing the case if this has not been done, or has been done incorrectly, by the participant).
  • Community contributions are allowed, but must be limited to the specific case. It is not allowed to add other contributions, references to sponsorships or anything else that isn’t in regard to the submission.
  • Preview images will be used to showcase the submission where appropriate. You agree that the Splash Awards Organising Committee and Kuoni have the authority to publish those images in relation to the Splash Awards International. Please indicate copyright when submitting your images.

Nominations and judging

  • An international jury of digital experts will review all submissions based on a diverse and well balanced set of criteria.
  • The jury assesses all submitted cases (see the criteria). Per category, the 5 cases with the highest average score will be nominated for the corresponding award.
  • Within each category, a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 5 cases will be nominated for the International Splash Award for that category. In case of a tie for the 5th place, all 5th place cases will be nominated for the International Splash Award in that category, causing the number of nominees to be greater than 5.
  • If there are less than 3 entries in one specific category, the category will lapse. If a category lapses, all participants will be notified and offered the option to change their submission to a different category at no extra costs.
  • The nominee with the highest average score in a category will be the winner in that category.
  • The nominee with the second-highest average score in a category will win the Runner-Up in that category.
  • In case of a tie for the winner in a category, the jury will discuss the cases and hold a second voting round. Only one nominee will be the winner of a category.
  • In case of a tie for the Runner-Up, both cases will be awarded Runner-Up.
  • If a jury member has an affiliation with the organisation that has submitted a case, the jury member has already agreed to recuse themself from judging the submission. Another jury member will judge the project in their stead.

Unacceptable submissions and disqualification

  • Entries that contain pornographic material, propagate “hate” messages, make defamatory statements, or which are otherwise offensive are not eligible and will be disqualified.
  • The International Splash Awards, including the International Splash Awards Ceremony adhere to the DrupalCon Code of Conduct
  • Ineligible entries may be disqualified at any phase of the competition without notification.

Code of Conduct

The International Splash Awards follow the Drupal Community's Code of Conduct. Please follow those guidelines.

Conflicts in our community can take many forms. Disagreements, social and technical, are normal, but we do not allow them to persist and fester leaving others uncertain of the agreed direction.

We expect individuals to first try to resolve conflicts between themselves in a constructive manner, asking for help when needed. This approach gives people more control over the outcome of their dispute.

If that fails, we escalate the matter to structures with designated leaders to step in and provide clarity and direction. When conflicts do arise there is a thought-out and agreed process for resolving them: Conflict Resolution Policy.

We will not tolerate bullying or harassment of any member of the Drupal community.

If you feel threatened or violated as a result of intimidating, bullying, harassing, abusive, discriminatory, derogatory, or demeaning conduct, please speak up and ask it to stop. If you do not feel that you can speak up, contact the Community Working Group immediately with evidence of the incident. Incidents of bullying and harassment can be reported privately and will be treated seriously and discreetly. Use this Incident Report Form.

Please speak up if you notice someone else being subjected to such behaviour.

Visa Information

Do You Need a Visa to Stay in the Netherlands?

Visa Exemptions: Citizens of the European Union (EU), European Economic Area (EEA), and Switzerland do not require a visa for short stays (up to 90 days within a 180-day period) for tourism, business, or family visits.

Visa Requirements: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries may need a visa, depending on their nationality, the purpose of their visit, and the duration of their stay. If you are unsure whether you need a visa, please review the Schengen Visa requirements and start your application as early as possible.

Where to apply for a Visa

If you require a visa, we strongly recommend applying well in advance. Visa applications should be submitted to the Dutch embassy or consulate in your country. For specific questions, please contact the Dutch diplomatic mission closest to you.

Where can I find my invitation letter?

The DrupalCon Europe organizing team is happy to issue an official letter of invitation to DrupalCon attendees who must obtain a visa for travel to the Netherlands. Please note this letter does not constitute any financial commitment on the part of the conference. During the registration process for DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 you will be asked if an invitation letter for visa purposes is needed. If you check yes, an invitation letter will be sent to you by email after registration. Please note that the invitation letter is only issued to attendees with fully paid registration.

Additional Information

  • Passport Validity: Ensure your passport is valid for at least three months beyond your planned date of departure from the Netherlands and the Schengen Area.
  • Health Insurance: It’s advisable to have valid health insurance that covers the entire Schengen Area during your stay.

For more detailed and country-specific information, always check with the nearest Dutch embassy or consulate.

Our Sponsors & Partners

DrupalCon Europe is bringing together a diverse community of individuals passionate about the Drupal platform. Drawing participants from around the world, the event serves as a nexus for users, developers, designers, and supporters to collaborate, share insights, and advance their expertise in Drupal. Through a dynamic mix of sessions, workshops, and networking opportunities, DrupalCon fosters innovation and strengthens the bonds within this thriving open-source community. 

Our sponsors have a unique opportunity to showcase their commitment to open source, gain visibility, and contribute to the success of the event. We are grateful for the support of our sponsors, whose partnership helps make DrupalCon Europe possible and enables us to continue bringing the global Drupal community together.

Drupaljam is an official event partner
Image

DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 is proud to partner with Drupaljam, the annual event of Stichting Drupal Nederland. Together, we're bringing the international and Dutch Drupal communities even closer, creating more opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate open source throughout the event.

Part of the partnership is the Drupaljam House, an open community space that will be welcoming attendees throughout the conference. Visitors will find an informal meeting spot featuring Dutch cultural touches. The Drupaljam House will serve as a central hub where the international community and the Dutch Drupal sector can connect.

BoF Sessions

Image
What are Birds of a Feather (BoF) Sessions?

Discuss Drupal and other technology-related topics, gather together based on affinity, or meet fellow attendees with similar identities through informal birds of a feather (BoF) groups! BoFs don't need to be about the community or even Drupal, they may also be held to discuss coffee or knitting patterns. Have fun and learn! BoFs exist to provide attendees with an inclusive, informal environment in which to share ideas freely. BoFs can be serious, and a great way to gather the people you’ve been working with remotely on a project in a space to deep dive on a topic, but they can also be fun as well.

Submit BoF
Why Attend a BoF Session?
  • Inclusivity and Informality: BoFs provide an inclusive, informal environment where attendees can freely share ideas. 
  • Community Building: Meet and network with others who share your interests, whether they are related to Drupal, technology, or personal hobbies. 
  • Flexibility: BoFs can be serious or fun, providing a space to dive deep into a topic or simply enjoy a casual conversation. 
A Bit of History

Drupal Europe was conceived in a series of BoF sessions, emphasizing their importance in fostering collaboration and innovation within the community. We continue this tradition by offering several BoF spaces at DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026. 

How to Submit a BoF?

Eligibility: Only registered DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 attendees can submit BoFs. 

  1. Sign In: Use your account email address and password to access the BoF Portal. 
  2. Not Registered Yet?: Register for DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 now to participate. 
  3. Submission Process: 
  • Submit your BoF as soon as possible, and at least 24 hours before the scheduled time. 
  • BoF sessions are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis. 
  • The portal will close once all rooms are booked or by Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 6pm (CEST). 
Important Tips
  • Check the Schedule: Ensure you know which room your BoF is taking place in and join the corresponding room. 
  • Missed the 24-hour Deadline? Check the schedule for available rooms onsite and use one if it’s free. 
  • Timeslot Conflicts: If your chosen timeslot is already booked, we will contact you by email to select another convenient timeslot. 
Rules and Conditions

BoFs are for discussion rather than formal presentations or sales pitches and must follow the DrupalCon Code of Conduct. BoFs are accessible to all, however attendees must respect boundaries communicated in the BoF title and description. We reserve the right to remove BoFs which violate the Code of Conduct, appear offensive, presentation-driven, or sales-focused.

Registrants who add BoFs are volunteering to act as a BoF facilitator. BoF facilitators should be in the room on time, welcome attendees, encourage participation, and help to guide the discussion.

Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding your BoF submission, please contact us at drupal@kuonitumlare.com.

Women in Drupal Award 2026

Image

The Women in Drupal Award, sponsored by Jakala, celebrates the women making a difference across the Drupal ecosystem.

Now in its fifth year, the award recognises individuals whose talent, leadership, creativity, and commitment help strengthen the Drupal community and shape its future.

We know that impact comes in many forms. Whether someone is writing code, leading teams, designing experiences, growing businesses, mentoring others, organising events, contributing to open source, or championing inclusion, their work deserves recognition.

Join us on Tuesday, 29 September, as we come together to celebrate the women who make a difference in the Drupal community.

Who can be nominated?

The award is open to women from across the Drupal community, including:

Developers and architects
Designers and UX specialists
Strategists and consultants
Marketers and business leaders
Recruiters and talent specialists
Founders and entrepreneurs
Community organisers and advocates
Contributors, mentors, and volunteers

This list is not exhaustive. If someone has made a meaningful contribution to Drupal, the community, or the wider open-source ecosystem, we’d love to hear about them.

Why nominate?

By nominating someone, you’re helping to celebrate their achievements, amplify their contributions, and inspire others across the community.

Whether they’ve delivered exceptional work, supported others through mentorship, helped grow the community, or consistently gone above and beyond, your nomination helps ensure their impact is recognised.

How are nominees evaluated?

Nominations will be reviewed by an independent panel of judges drawn from across the Drupal community and previous award winners.

Judges will consider the nominee’s overall contribution, impact, leadership, and commitment to the Drupal ecosystem.

Who makes the selection?

The Women in Drupal Award Jury consists of members of the Drupal Association, winners from last year and the creator of the award, JAKALA:

Social Events

International Splash Awards

After Vienna, the International Splash Awards continue their tradition at DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026, taking place this September in Rotterdam. 

The Splash Awards recognize exceptional projects from a wide range of industries, showcasing the remarkable work of Drupal agencies, freelancers, and organizations worldwide.

Join us for an unforgettable evening featuring a glamorous gala atmosphere, red carpet moments, and live entertainment.

Date: Monday, 28 September 2026
Time: 19:30 - 21:00 CEST
Location: ss Rotterdam, 3e Katendrechtsehoofd 25, 3072 AM Rotterdam

More about International Splash Awards
Image
Opening Ceremony

Join the Opening Ceremony for an exciting start to DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026! To launch the event, the Organizing Secretariat, Advisory Board members, and Drupal Association staff are eager to welcome you to the vibrant city of Rotterdam.

We'll begin with essential event information and set the stage for the first keynote of the week. Don't miss this opportunity to kick off your DrupalCon experience on a high note and prepare for an incredible few days ahead!

Date: Tuesday, 29 September 2026
Time: 09:00 - 10:30 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Rotterdam Room I&II

Image
Women in Drupal Award

Join us as we honor the remarkable women who have made a significant impact in Drupal through leadership, innovation, and community engagement. This prestigious recognition highlights their dedication and achievements.

Our goal is to foster inclusivity and embrace individuals across the gender spectrum. Be part of a community that values diversity and excellence as we recognize the contributions of women in Drupal-related projects.

We look forward to celebrating with you!

Date: Tuesday, 29 September 2026
Time: 18:00 - 18:20 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Rotterdam Room I&II

Learn more and nominate
Image
Opening Reception

After a day of contributions, inspiring sessions, and exploring the exhibition, it’s time to officially kick off DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026! Connect with fellow attendees over refreshments, appetizers, and great conversations.

This is your chance to meet the Drupal community, build new connections, and set the tone for an incredible week ahead. Don’t miss this memorable start to an inspiring event.

Date: Tuesday, 29 September 2026
Time: 18:20 - 19:20 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Exhibition Hall

Image
#IAmRemarkable Workshop

The #IAmRemarkable Workshop is an interactive session designed to help participants recognise their achievements and build confidence in talking about them. It explores how imposter syndrome, stereotypes, and cultural expectations can make self-promotion feel uncomfortable.

Part of the global #IAmRemarkable movement, the workshop encourages everyone, including people from underrepresented groups, to celebrate their accomplishments in the workplace and beyond while challenging perceptions around self-promotion.

Date: Wednesday, 30 September 2026
Time: 10:45 - 12:25 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Blue Room

More about #IAmRemarkable Workshop
Image
Women in Drupal Networking Event

We're hosting a Women in Drupal networking lunch in collaboration with our sponsor JAKALA. We want to provide the brilliant women in our Drupal community a dedicated space for meaningful conversations, shared experiences, and the opportunity to build connections.

Whether you're a newcomer attending your first DrupalCon or a long-time contributor to the Drupal community, we hope you'll join us. This gathering is designed to foster inclusion, encourage networking and collaboration, celebrate the presence and contributions of women in tech, and help you feel supported in your journey.

This event is open to all who identify as women, as well as non-binary and other gender-diverse people who feel comfortable in a space centring women’s experiences. 

Date: Wednesday, 30 September 
Time: 12:25 - 13:40 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Blue Room

Image
Wrap up Ceremony

As DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026 comes to a close, join us for one final gathering to celebrate everything we’ve achieved together. We’ll review important discussions, revisit hot topics, and set the stage for the future. This is a moment to reflect on the highlights of the week, share key takeaways, and look ahead to what’s next for the Drupal community.

Let’s wrap up this incredible journey with energy, inspiration, and a shared vision for the road ahead. See you there!

Date: Wednesday, 30 September 2026
Time: 18:00 - 18:30 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Rotterdam Room I&II

Image
Trivia Night

Join us for a classic pub quiz , covering all things Drupal along with a sprinkle of general web topics. Gather your team of five (5) and compete for the title of Drupal trivia champions, with small prizes up for grabs! 

Remember, this is a test of your Drupal expertise - no mobile devices or laptops allowed. It's all about what you know off the top of your head! 

Date: Wednesday, 30 September 2026
Time: 19:30 - 23:30 CEST
Location: Oase Rotterdam, Schiehavenweg 15-A, 3024 EC Rotterdam

Community Events

DrupalCon is more than just sessions, BoFs, and contribution rooms. It’s also about building connections beyond the conference! In addition to popular events like Trivia Night, we encourage you to organize your own meetups, whether it’s a local community gathering, a morning run, or an after-session catch-up.

We’re happy to help promote your event and showcase it on the official website to reach a broader audience. Please note that all social events must follow the Code of Conduct, and not all submitted events may be listed.

Submit your ideas and reach out to us at drupal@kuonitumlare.com for any questions.

Drupal Association Partner Lunch

The Drupal Partner Lunch is an exclusive gathering for agency leaders and C-suite executives shaping the Drupal business ecosystem. Following the Driesnote, attendees will have the opportunity to hear directly from Drupal project founder and project lead Dries Buytaert, enjoy lunch together, and engage in an open conversation with Dries and Drupal Association Leadership.

This is a chance to ask questions about the Driesnote, the direction of the Drupal Association, and the Drupal business ecosystem moving forward, all while connecting with peers over lunch.

Space is limited, and pre-registration is required. Reserve your spot using the link below.

Date: Tuesday, 29 September 2026
Time: 12:00 - 13:30 CEST
Location: Postillion Hotel & Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Tokyo Room
